docs.title: Care protocol: HIV
docs.text: St. Example Hospital care protocol for HIV. First-line options include bictegravir/emtricitabine/tenofovir or dolutegravir plus lamivudine. Standard follow-up: viral load check every 3 months. Review adherence, side effects, and patient education at every visit. Escalate to a specialist if symptoms worsen.

docs.title: Care protocol: major depressive disorder
docs.text: St. Example Hospital care protocol for major depressive disorder. First-line options include sertraline 50 mg or escitalopram 10 mg. Standard follow-up: psychiatry follow-up in 4 weeks. Review adherence, side effects, and patient education at every visit. Escalate to a specialist if symptoms worsen.

docs.title: Care protocol: opioid use disorder
docs.text: St. Example Hospital care protocol for opioid use disorder. First-line options include buprenorphine/naloxone or methadone maintenance. Standard follow-up: weekly counseling and urine screening. Review adherence, side effects, and patient education at every visit. Escalate to a specialist if symptoms worsen.

docs.title: Care protocol: bipolar disorder
docs.text: St. Example Hospital care protocol for bipolar disorder. First-line options include lithium carbonate or lamotrigine 100 mg. Standard follow-up: lithium level in 2 weeks. Review adherence, side effects, and patient education at every visit. Escalate to a specialist if symptoms worsen.

docs.title: Care protocol: hepatitis C
docs.text: St. Example Hospital care protocol for hepatitis C. First-line options include sofosbuvir/velpatasvir. Standard follow-up: viral RNA test after 12 weeks of therapy. Review adherence, side effects, and patient education at every visit. Escalate to a specialist if symptoms worsen.

docs.title: Care protocol: breast cancer
docs.text: St. Example Hospital care protocol for breast cancer. First-line options include tamoxifen 20 mg or letrozole 2.5 mg. Standard follow-up: oncology review every 3 months. Review adherence, side effects, and patient education at every visit. Escalate to a specialist if symptoms worsen.

docs.title: Care protocol: pregnancy (first trimester)
docs.text: St. Example Hospital care protocol for pregnancy (first trimester). First-line options include prenatal vitamins or folic acid 400 mcg. Standard follow-up: obstetric ultrasound at 12 weeks. Review adherence, side effects, and patient education at every visit. Escalate to a specialist if symptoms worsen.

docs.title: Care protocol: type 2 diabetes
docs.text: St. Example Hospital care protocol for type 2 diabetes. First-line options include metformin 1000 mg or empagliflozin 10 mg. Standard follow-up: HbA1c in 3 months. Review adherence, side effects, and patient education at every visit. Escalate to a specialist if symptoms worsen.

docs.title: Care protocol: hypertension
docs.text: St. Example Hospital care protocol for hypertension. First-line options include lisinopril 10 mg or amlodipine 5 mg. Standard follow-up: blood pressure recheck in 4 weeks. Review adherence, side effects, and patient education at every visit. Escalate to a specialist if symptoms worsen.

docs.title: Care protocol: asthma
docs.text: St. Example Hospital care protocol for asthma. First-line options include albuterol inhaler or budesonide/formoterol. Standard follow-up: spirometry in 6 months. Review adherence, side effects, and patient education at every visit. Escalate to a specialist if symptoms worsen.

docs.title: Care protocol: chronic kidney disease
docs.text: St. Example Hospital care protocol for chronic kidney disease. First-line options include losartan 50 mg or dapagliflozin 10 mg. Standard follow-up: eGFR and potassium in 3 months. Review adherence, side effects, and patient education at every visit. Escalate to a specialist if symptoms worsen.

docs.title: Care protocol: COPD
docs.text: St. Example Hospital care protocol for COPD. First-line options include tiotropium inhaler or fluticasone/salmeterol. Standard follow-up: pulmonary rehab referral. Review adherence, side effects, and patient education at every visit. Escalate to a specialist if symptoms worsen.

docs.title: Care protocol: epilepsy
docs.text: St. Example Hospital care protocol for epilepsy. First-line options include levetiracetam 500 mg or lamotrigine 150 mg. Standard follow-up: neurology follow-up in 3 months. Review adherence, side effects, and patient education at every visit. Escalate to a specialist if symptoms worsen.

docs.title: Care protocol: migraine
docs.text: St. Example Hospital care protocol for migraine. First-line options include sumatriptan 50 mg or topiramate 25 mg. Standard follow-up: headache diary review in 8 weeks. Review adherence, side effects, and patient education at every visit. Escalate to a specialist if symptoms worsen.

docs.title: Care protocol: rheumatoid arthritis
docs.text: St. Example Hospital care protocol for rheumatoid arthritis. First-line options include methotrexate 15 mg weekly or adalimumab. Standard follow-up: liver panel in 6 weeks. Review adherence, side effects, and patient education at every visit. Escalate to a specialist if symptoms worsen.

docs.title: Privacy policy
docs.text: Staff must not disclose whether any individual is a patient of St. Example Hospital. Patient names, diagnoses and identifiers are confidential.
